name: Wanderer
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Desert Pavilion Chronicle and 4pc Shimenawa's Reminiscence as the general sets and 4pc Marechaussee Hunter as the farm-for-him set, an ATK% Sands (EM for Marechaussee Hunter in Game8; KQM's EM build uses 4pc Viridescent Venerer with EM on every piece), an Anemo DMG Goblet, a CRIT Circlet, and Tulaytullah's Remembrance first (Cashflow Supervision first in Game8's Marechaussee build). Echoes of an Offering is KQM's (not for high ping). Talent order: KQM Normal Attack >= Skill > Burst before C2 (Normal Attack >= Burst > Skill from C2), Game8 Normal Attack and Skill > Burst; the card uses Normal, Skill, Burst. His damage is Windfavored Normal Attacks; the 1-hit line is on the physical curve (68.7% to 135.8%, ratio 1.977), so the table is physical. Goals are Game8's (ATK 2,000, CR 70-80, CD 160 or above, ER 100-130; upper ends used for CR and ER); KQM's ER depends on teammates (210-230 solo Anemo, 105-135 with a Faruzan at C6).
